Distribution Agapostemon subtilior is a widespread species that ranges from coast to coast across the northern and central US, and it extends down further south in the western US, especially in California, where we have confirmed it as far south as the border of Mexico. The distribution is surprisingly similar to that of Bombus fervidus (Fabricius, 1798) s. lat. (i. e., B. fervidus + B. californicus Smith, 1854). Agapostemon subtilior extends further south in the eastern US along the Appalachian Mountains (Roberts 1972), but we have not had the opportunity to examine those specimens (recent records from further southeast, such as Florida, all appear to be georeferencing errors or misidentifications). We have confirmed specimens from: CA, CO, CT, IA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MT, ND, NH, NM, NY, OH, OR, RI, SD, UT, WA, WI and WY. Agapostemon subtilior appears to be a common species throughout most of its range.
